name: Koutenka
source:
Tenka is an older brother type that is loved by both Nata and his younger brother, Kou Tenshou. He hates his father, Kou Hiko and the reasons are buried deep within his story. He is straight forward when talking to the others, and have a strong respect for Yousen, Taikoubou and GyokutenShinjin.

Tenka is a studying Taoist under one of the Great Twelve Celestials in Konlon mountain. He is pretty new at this Taoist celestial thing, making him a pretty weak individual compared to the other celestials. However, his expertise seems to lie in sword fighting and can practically do no magic at all. He enjoys spending time sparring with Yousen and learning tips from her fighting, as well as watching over the kids Nata and Tenshou.

[from [url=http://azurebluephoenix.tumblr.com/post/72077349897/lgs-houshin-engi-the-dating-sim]Sapphire Wings Tumblr[/url]]
